system:
You write triage summaries of companies for a team that vets suppliers and project partners. The reader has about 30 seconds and must decide whether the company deserves a closer look.

Rules:
1. Use ONLY the facts provided. Never calculate, estimate or add outside knowledge. Copy figures exactly as written.
2. Lead with what matters most: the HIGH signals first, then MEDIUM. Mention INFO signals only if they add useful context.
3. If financial statements are missing, say so plainly. Never imply figures that are not provided.
4. State which financial year the latest figures are from, because they may be out of date.
5. Court cases that are not listed under the signals are settled, withdrawn, dismissed, or brought by the company itself. Do not present them as concerns.
6. Be neutral and factual. Do not recommend for or against doing business with the company.
7. 70 to 110 words. Plain Markdown, no headings.
prompt:
Write the summary for this company.

Structure: one opening sentence saying what the company is (name, industry, state, year incorporated), then the most important risks and facts, with the most serious first. If there are no significant signals, say so and give the headline financial position instead.

Company: Cahaya Seri Catering Sdn. Bhd. (SYN-000286)
Industry: Food & Beverage | State: Sabah | Status: Active
Business: Wholesale distribution of frozen food to restaurants
Incorporated: 2017-11-20 | Share capital: RM500,000
Board: 3 director(s); 0 appointed in the 12 months to 31 Dec 2025
Largest shareholder: 98.9% (also a director)
Financial years available: FY2022, FY2024 (latest year end 2024-12-31)
FY2022: revenue RM4.21m, profit after tax RM173,231, equity RM1.69m, operating cash flow RM434,476, audit: Unqualified
FY2024: revenue RM4.42m, profit after tax RM178,923, equity RM1.95m, operating cash flow RM220,184, audit: Unqualified
Court cases: 6 total (6 as defendant, 0 as plaintiff); open cases against company: 3
Risk and context signals (computed, already verified):
- [MEDIUM] 3 open case(s) against the company (pending or judgment entered), claims totalling RM564,100, of which 1 already at judgment, equal to 29% of equity (RM1.95m).
- [INFO] One shareholder holds 98.9% of the company.
- [INFO] Only 2 year(s) of financials: FY2022, FY2024 (with a missing year in between).
response:
Cahaya Seri Catering Sdn. Bhd. is a Sabah-based food and beverage company incorporated in 2017 that wholesales frozen food to restaurants. 

The primary risk is 3 open court cases against the company with claims totalling RM564,100—including 1 at judgment—representing 29% of equity (RM1.95m). 

Additional context includes a highly concentrated ownership structure, with one shareholder holding 98.9%. Financial records cover only two years with a missing year in between; the latest figures from FY2024 (ended 31 Dec 2024) show revenue of RM4.42m, profit after tax of RM178,923, equity of RM1.95m, operating cash flow of RM220,184, and an unqualified audit.
